_comment: Free AI directory submit list for Pikbo (https://pikbo.ai). free=false skips paid. Updated 2026-07-27 cycle 2: added 10 new free dirs, restored 2 broken dirs. status_hint=done = already submitted.

product.name: Pikbo
product.tagline: Turn one designer-toy photo into a short AI video
product.description: Pikbo is an AI video suite for designer toys, blind boxes, and figures. Upload one owned product photo, pick a recipe (360 spin, unbox, float), generate a short clip for listings and social. Free Mini trial - no card. Soft launch: Seedance Mini, honest limits, no fake multi-model zoo.
